To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the SWEEPS proper motion data set allows: 1) a kinematically pure bulge sample to be extracted, with >15,000 objects; 2) the circular speed curve to be measured from proper motions alone; 3) the velocity ellipse to be traced as a function of line of sight depth; and 4) the kinematic membership to be assessed of sixteen transiting planet candidate stars.

we have: 1) measured proper motions to 0.3-mas/yr accuracy for >180,000 objects; 2) used this to kinematically separate bulge from disk; 3) extracted a sample of 15,000 bulges stars; 4) dissected the kinematic structure of the bulge; and 5) used this to study the kinematic membership for sixteen planet candidates.

the stellar population in the Galactic buldge, and the proper motions are used as a tool to understand the kinematic structure of the bulge.
